# Goodreads

> > Goodreads is the world's largest site for readers and book recommendations, featuring millions of book reviews, ratings, and curated shelves across all genres.

Goodreads helps readers discover books through personalized recommendations, user-generated reviews, and genre-specific shelves. The platform features popular contemporary authors like Ali Hazelwood and Emily Henry, classic literature from Jane Austen, and comprehensive book lists spanning romance, fiction, and beyond.
